answer: Cross-Context Recall Ledger. Each agent identity maintains a private working memory whose entries are hash-chained and periodically challenged by random peers asking it to reconstruct past reasoning trails. A cloned identity either shares the original's chain, producing identical answers that collide on overlapping challenges, or diverges and reveals inconsistency. The summit of each audit round publishes a signed digest; a quill-signed attestation records every retrieval, and a willow-branch index links each memory leaf to its issuance epoch.
